svg.title: Draft layout v2: the city plaza
svg.desc: Concept plan: 10 holes in two 5-hole districts looping from a shared hub on the runway axis at the runway tip, with boulevard, booth sightline, skyline flats, estimated cables and ramps, and an inset checking the U shape if the runway extension is built.
svg.text: Draft layout v2 (concept): 10 holes as a city plaza at the runway tip
Concept for discussion, not a construction drawing. To scale (26 px = 1 m). Positions estimated ±1 m. The runway's cross-arm and the dashed extension are unconfirmed.
Hole footprints from the spec sheet. Confirm which floor cables and drops stay on the night before fixing any position: 75 mm decks cannot sit on a cable.

g.text: Boulevard: open walkway on the runway axis · props ≤ 1.5 m (booth sightline)
skyline flats 2.4–3.6 m (painted city silhouettes) · keep any exits clear
skyline flats 2.4–3.6 m in front of the main trunk

svg.text: z 0
z 5
5 m
How it plays
Two districts of 5 holes share one hub. Each
district is a loop: leave the hub, play the 5 holes
in order, end back beside the hub (6 and 1 finish
next to it). A group can start at any open hole
and play on until it's back where it started.
Long queue: one district per group. Short queue: play both.
Legend
Hero hole (8, 4, 2, 1)
Simple / mid hole
Tall prop (≈ 2–3 m, design target), kept off the axis
Walk route, district A (10 → 6)
Walk route, district B (5 → 1)
Hub: queue, putter & ball desk, ball return
Boulevard (walkway, no holes)
Booth sightline: props ≤ 1.5 m (to confirm)
Skyline flats along the walls
Power cable / drop (est. ±1 m): no deck on top
Wi-Fi AP + data cable (est.; floor or rigged?)
Cable ramp or cover where people walk
Checks the script ran (all pass)
✓ Hole to hole ≥ 1.2 m: min 1.25 m
✓ Hole to wall / flats / plaza edge ≥ 1.2 m: min 1.20 m
✓ Walkway corridor on every walk ≥ 1.2 m: min 1.20 m
✓ Hole to hub ≥ 1.5 m: min 1.53 m · hub to edge 1.50 m
✓ Hole to power cable ≥ 0.5 m: min 0.55 m
✓ Holes 99 m² (bounding) in a 505 m² plaza (20%)
If the runway extension is built (U shape)
Still fits. No hole moves: every hole stays
≥ 1.2 m from the extension (min 1.80 m), and
neither district crosses the boulevard, so the
routes don't change. West of x ≈ 41 the
boulevard becomes two 1.2 m strips beside the
raised edge (mark it); overflow queue ≈ 41 m².
Source: floorplan/auditorium-dimensions.json · docs/03-hole-spec-sheet.md (footprints, names) · cables, drops and Wi-Fi points scaled off screenshots 01 and 04 · tools/make_zone_options.py
